Source: https://www.nijiyome.com/app/top/kagura_taisen

It been 11 years and no one still making album of this game at all so I decide to take it upon myself.
However I don't know how to datamined the game so I couldn't get every card image due to method I use.
Which is develop tools then keep doing reroll pay banner for card to appear.
But there no way I can keep doing this until I get every card, it too much rng.
Also the image I got is the smallest one too.
There actually a non-frame version image if you own the card which bigger than this.
And there are upgrade version which give you lewder version of art too (you need to combine dupe for it) so it impossible to get it from gacha itself.
Also the reroll pay banner doesn't show R rarity card.
So this album will remain incomplete until someone who can datamined this game decide to upload complete version or teach how to datamined the game.

Honestly the reason I make this album is just to be awareness to people so they might interesting in taking a look at the game.
